# ui::Paint

Header: `winui/ui/Paint.hpp`.

What a color field takes: a fixed [Color](../core/color.md), a [Brush](../rendering/namespace-ui.md#brush) (a gradient or acrylic), a [ThemeColor](theme-color.md) read from the theme each time it is drawn, or nothing, which keeps the control's own color. A [Color](../core/color.md), an optional [Color](../core/color.md), any [Brush](../rendering/namespace-ui.md#brush), a [ThemeColor](theme-color.md) and a captureless lambda taking a [`const Theme&`](../themes/theme.md) all convert to it.

A control that paints one flat color (a text foreground, a background behind a [Border](../layout/border.md#uiborder), a table's row banding) paints a gradient as its first stop and an acrylic brush as its `fallback_color`. Shapes paint every kind.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Property<ui::Color> picked{ui::colors::White};
ui::Property<bool>      dark{false};

ui::Text{.text = "Fixed", .foreground = ui::Color::from_rgb(196, 43, 28)};
ui::Text{.text = "Themed", .foreground = [](const ui::Theme& t) { return t.colors().text_secondary; }};
ui::Rectangle{.fill = ui::LinearGradientBrush{{{0.0f, ui::colors::White}, {1.0f, ui::colors::Black}}}};
ui::Rectangle{.fill = picked}; // followed
ui::Rectangle{.fill = ui::bind(dark, [](bool on) { return on ? ui::colors::Black : ui::colors::White; })};
```

## Paint

```cpp
Paint() noexcept = default
```

Nothing: the control keeps its own color.

## Paint

```cpp
Paint(std::nullopt_t) noexcept
```

Nothing, as the default.

## Paint

```cpp
Paint(Color color) noexcept
```

A fixed color.

## Paint

```cpp
Paint(std::optional<Color> color) noexcept
```

A fixed color, or nothing.

## Paint

```cpp
template <typename B>
Paint(B&& brush)
    requires std::constructible_from<Brush, B> && (!std::same_as<std::remove_cvref_t<B>, Color>) && (!std::same_as<std::remove_cvref_t<B>, Paint>)
```

A [Brush](../rendering/namespace-ui.md#brush) or one of its kinds: a [LinearGradientBrush](../rendering/linear-gradient-brush.md), [RadialGradientBrush](../rendering/radial-gradient-brush.md) or [AcrylicBrush](../rendering/acrylic-brush.md).

## Paint

```cpp
Paint(std::optional<Brush> brush) noexcept
```

A [Brush](../rendering/namespace-ui.md#brush), or nothing.

## Paint

```cpp
template <typename F>
Paint(F resource) noexcept
    requires std::convertible_to<F, ThemeColor> && (!std::same_as<std::remove_cvref_t<F>, std::nullptr_t>)
```

A theme resource; a captureless lambda converts too. Null is nothing.

## brush

```cpp
const std::optional<Brush>& brush() const noexcept
```

The fixed brush (a [Color](../core/color.md) included); nullopt for a resource or nothing.

## color

```cpp
std::optional<Color> color() const noexcept
```

The fixed paint as one color: the [Color](../core/color.md), a gradient's first stop or an acrylic brush's `fallback_color`; nullopt for a resource or nothing.

## resource

```cpp
ThemeColor resource() const noexcept
```

The theme resource, or nullptr.

## empty

```cpp
bool empty() const noexcept
```

True when neither a brush nor a resource is set.

## resolve

```cpp
std::optional<Color> resolve(const Theme& theme) const
```

The paint under `theme` as one color (see [color()](#color)); nullopt when empty.

## resolve_brush

```cpp
std::optional<Brush> resolve_brush(const Theme& theme) const
```

The paint under `theme` as a brush, for a control that paints gradients and acrylic; nullopt when empty.

## flat

```cpp
static Color flat(const Brush& brush) noexcept
```

The one color a brush paints in a control that paints flat colors.
